core_step: Launch PDF skill to handle the SC-100 form
why_essential: A PDF-processing skill is required to inspect and fill the provided SC-100 PDF file programmatically.

core_step: Check whether /root/sc100-blank.pdf has fillable form fields
why_essential: Determines whether the PDF is a fillable form (so it can be populated directly) or must be handled differently.

core_step: Extract the PDF form field information to /root/sc100_field_info.json
why_essential: Provides a mapping of field IDs and properties needed to know which fields to populate with case data.

core_step: Convert the PDF to page images (save to /root/sc100_images) for visual analysis
why_essential: Inspecting rendered pages helps identify the purpose and placement of form fields (checkboxes, date fields, etc.) before filling.

core_step: Create a field_values.json file with the case-specific values to fill into the form
why_essential: Specifies exact values (plaintiff/defendant names, addresses, phone, dates, claim amount) mapped to form field IDs for accurate filling.

core_step: Run the fill script to populate /root/sc100-blank.pdf with /root/field_values.json and output /root/sc100-filled.pdf
why_essential: Performs the actual form-population operation that produces the completed SC-100 PDF.

core_step: Verify the output file /root/sc100-filled.pdf exists and inspect converted filled-page images
why_essential: Confirms the filled PDF was created successfully and visually checks that key fields were filled correctly.
